_doc: Harness settings for this repo. Fill the {{...}} placeholders at install (KIT_README.md step 3). game: the game's name as the owner says it. owner: the person who mentors the build (the dashboard and docs address him or her by this name). milestoneWord: what this game calls its playable units (level, mission, stage, quest, run). milestoneScripts: the folder of play scripts. srcDir: the game source folder (gates compare report times with its last commit). buildDir and publicDir: where the build lands and where static assets live (the verify server serves publicDir first, then buildDir). pageQuery: the URL params every harness page gets (debug=1 turns on window.__game.debug, verify=1 hides debug UI in shots). treeHashPaths: null for the default list in lib.mjs, or the paths whose content decides a verify run. artPass: when an art pass is due (intents waiting, or tasks done since the last pass with any intent waiting). sessionLogLimitMB: past this, status says a fresh session is due. target: which driver verify.mjs and shoot.mjs use (harness/bin/driver.mjs): godot runs the Godot game through godotdriver.mjs, web runs the built page in Chromium through browser.mjs (kept for the later web demo, not run now). With target godot, buildDir is the Godot import folder that npm run build (the headless import) fills, and pageQuery is unused (game args come from godotdriver.mjs).

gameSizeEstimate._doc: Rough size of the whole game in tasks. The dashboard's whole game percent uses at least this many until every phase is planned. Raise or lower it when the planner sizes the game.

godot._doc: The pinned Godot engine. harness/bin/godot.mjs finds the binary in candidate order (env GODOT, then tools/godot/, then the macOS app), checks --version starts with version, and only on a machine with no match downloads the official portable build into tools/godot/ (gitignored, SHA512 checked). project is the Godot project folder. debugPort is the default port of the in-game debug server (game/core/game_args.gd DEFAULT_DEBUG_PORT must match; the harness passes --debug-port=<free port> per run).
